description: FDA drug label side-by-side — Compare two medicines side by side from their official FDA labels (openFDA SPL): brand/generic, Rx or OTC, route, pharmacologic class, boxed warning, indications, contraindications, pregnancy, common adverse reactions - plus whether either label names the other drug or its drug class in its interaction, warning or contraindication text (with excerpts). Verdict: SAME_INGREDIENT / INTERACTION_MENTIONED / CLASS_INTERACTION_MENTIONED / SAME_CLASS_DUPLICATE_THERAPY_RISK / NO_LABEL_MENTION_FOUND. a= and b= are generic or brand names. Label text only, not medical advice. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
